description: 前瞻基礎建設計畫-服務據點周邊及部落內公共設施改善核定明細 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 原住民族委員會. 前瞻基礎建設計畫於服務據點工程所在縣市區域及核定經費及施作說明。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 原住民族委員會. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, xml, csv. The portal shows 2026-04-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
